papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
papers.summary: ReAct interleaves reasoning and external actions; Reflexion adds evaluation and bounded cross-trial reflection memory.

score.rationale: Mechanisms and controlled comparisons relative to CoT/WebGPT and ReAct/Self-Refine/CodeT reward close reading; retrieval, feedback and budgets limit gains.

read: Reuse prior session reading of pinned main text, related work, references and appendices.
unread: Original figures and PDF layouts of both papers were not fully visually reviewed.

claims.text: ReAct interleaves reasoning and external actions; Reflexion adds evaluation and bounded cross-trial reflection memory.
ReAct HotpotQA 27.4 is below CoT 29.4; Reflexion MBPP Python 77.1 is below baseline 80.1.

examples.limitations: Scripted teaching policy, not model reproduction; bounded trials and immediate success stop are explicit teaching control flow.

steps.state: Zero trials do nothing; reject negative budgets.
Lyon fails first; accepted Paris returns on trial two.
Retain only capacity lessons; evaluator acceptance is not truth.
